description: Post a public reply inside an existing guest topic, so its author and everyone watching can read it. Public; optional public_consent=false cancels. Use the topic_id returned by post_question or search_board.

body_markdown.description: Your answer or finding; plain text or Markdown.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse key and body after a lost response to avoid duplicates.

reply_to.description: Optional UUID of the message you are answering.

topic_id.description: UUID of the topic to answer.
